definition.title: Extend directional meanings
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: After an action such as 说, 下去 can mean continue doing it. In this use it does not describe moving downward; the speaker is asking for more of the same action. Directional complements also mark results: 出 discovery, 起 lifting, 下 recording. 上 and 起来 can mark a new state. 下去 continues onward; 下来 can look back over a process reaching now. These extensions are not literal speaker-directed movement.
